description: Source code for a terminal test reporter class (ListReporter) used in Playwright testing framework, handling test output formatting, progress updates, and TTY interactions.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays test progress and results with support for TTY features.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test, assigns index, and outputs test title.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output from tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error output from tests.

methods.name: getStepIndex
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the index for a test step.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step, outputs step info.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates output.

methods.name: _maybeWriteNewLine
methods.description: Writes a new line if needed.

methods.name: _updateLineCountAndNewLineFlagForOutput
methods.description: Updates line and row counters based on output.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Outputs chunk to stdout or stderr.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing a test, outputs pause message.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles test end, updates output.

methods.name: _updateTestLine
methods.description: Updates the display line for a test.

methods.name: _updateOrAppendLine
methods.description: Updates or appends a line in the output.

methods.name: _appendLine
methods.description: Appends a line to output.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates a specific line in output.

methods.name: _updateLineForTTY
methods.description: Updates a line in TTY mode.

methods.name: _testPrefix
methods.description: Generates prefix string for test line.

methods.name: _retrySuffix
methods.description: Returns retry suffix string.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during test run.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles end of test run, outputs final message.
